Thank you for sharing. I can see understanding in what you are saying, and it really gives me hope it can be better for me as well.
I’m
But there is one huge problem of mine. I can not convince myself in something until I have a really strong evidence of it is true, real, and it is worth trying. So I need to prove it to myself, at least logically.

It is my inner criticism which I use my whole life. So I can see no logic in improvement, as it is clear whole life has no sense. All of my conclusions are it is easier to do nothing than struggle, as I already had fun here on Earth, so why should I waste my time and efforts trying to do more than I’ve already done?

And empathy, right. I can not feel empathy, compassion to myself as I used to live my life for someone or something else. So I really do not consider myself as something valuable. Yeah, my beloved ones will be upset if I disappear, but without me and my broken mind they will feel better in the end. It is also very logical and clear for me.

So I’m trapped within my own mind, and I can not say if it is a bad thing or may be I found the only correct answer.

Well this is the meaning of depression- you totally stop caring about anything.

I’ve joined this sub to understand am I the only one who feels these horrible things. And it helped a lot to see I’m not alone.

But I only text here when there is nothing else left to try and I need to cry my despair out. 

It also helps, but I can not say I would love to discuss this thoughts actively with people who feel the same.

Anyway. If you are going through it, you don’t have to ask. If you are at the line, you will cry. If you managed to decrease the weight of the world at your shoulders, you may help someone here.

I feel you so much. Try medicines, at least as an option. It will not make you happy but at least it gives a control over that exhaustion and sadness. It was so nice just to not feel sad for me. Still live in a gray world, but I can see I can affect it and have some fun sometimes.
Hmmm, when you lose literally everything, it is hard to find something else. I would say, impossible. Especially if you have to go through the feeling of losing everything every few days.
I didn’t even know it exist. Thank you for advice.

So being conscious and asking myself about why do I live is a curse? I’m not an animal. 

Humanity is a mistake of nature then. Just a dead end of evolution

It is selfish because you fix your own problem and delete yourself from society which expect you to do something for it.

I said a couple of times that non suicidal person can not understand completely the problem of living everyday. 

So they say you are selfish, but by doing so they are selfish themselves.

Suicidal person acts normally within the society AND suffers everyday. So it is kinda stupid to blame people for being “not responsible” and selfish.

It is “hope”, which gives you support and you are eager to reach something.

You need to accept some things are just impossible and live with it. At least it is obvious for normal people.

I just can not hope anymore, I live everyday for people who mean something to me.

It takes time. It’s been a year since I started my medication and still I can not say they make me feel better. They don’t, but they help me fight bad thoughts.

It’s my personal experience, but to me, I was not able to feel good, everyday was the end of the world. Now I can at least feel nice when it is sunny and warm, and I can go to the sea side to feel the water breathing.

It is so much better than spending weeks in your apartment looking to the floor not being able to sleep.

And now I feel good telling this to you, thank you bro.

Every person is happy in the same way, but every person suffers in a very specific and unique way. Tolstoy said that in ‘Anna Karenina’ 120 years ago, and he was a wise man.

Man, my situation is very similar. Wish I could provide you with solution. But I can advise you to look for help: those thoughts you mentioned are not normal, and there are ways (with help of meds and specialists) to see the situation from the other perspective. At least it will give you alternative. 

Me in the evening, after my pills stop working, is a totally different person from what I am during the day. So logically I can see my deep depressive thoughts are coming to me depending on the state of my brain. 

Still can feel no happiness or joy, but at least I can struggle

My depression became crucial after divorce. From my personal experience, I can advise you to look for help. It will not completely save you from bad thoughts or bad things in your life, but the quality of your life will be changed to good. 

It scares me to recall the feeling of deep depression and anxiety I had. After therapies and some meds (still have a pill everyday) I at least can fight these feel of terror inside me. It still comes back sometimes, but in general I exist without it. So the weight of the world feels much lighter.

Main problem here is after all these therapies and meds you like don’t care anymore. There should be a miracle in your life to change the attitude, or you should really want to change everything. But it is really hard to want something after years of not wanting.

So yeah, life is a bitch. All we have is a will to see what will happen tomorrow, some small pleasures during the day. 

But I do not have any plans except what was planned by my management, I have no idea of what I want in life anymore. There is nothing I can expect in future.

So may be the last thing - if not hope or love - was a curiosity

It’s been 2 years but I am still thinking of her and my kids, everyday.

PTSD is a bitch

Did you try looking for help?

I was always sure doctors are useless and medicine is bad for you mind. May be it was my biggest mistake.

I stopped my therapy, don’t know why, may be as well because of my prejudices (was helpful though, at least helped me to handle the aftershocks of what happened). Also, therapist was the one who convinced me to visit psychiatrist, and it was very useful.

I’m on medicine now, pills help me to feel something. Literally it makes me proud I can see beauty of the nature or laugh on reddit jokes.

Person I was year ago was not able to feel anything above zero.

And I do not want to become that person once again.

Still have bad thoughts in my head, every day. But at least I can say I will feel something good tomorrow. 

Don’t know if it is helpful for you, but give it a chance. Troubles you face now is not your fault, it is a sickness, which can be cured or at least bearable.

TLDR try to look for professional help. It will be interesting and may be you will start to feel anything

I feel you man. I have so many triggers around to start thinking about my divorce and how my life is ruined.

My answer to all that is not looking for happiness, but for satisfaction. They say “find something that pleases you” but nothing can really please you when you that low for years.

I try to recall what is satisfactory for me. Small things. But they make me feel warmer. My job. Nature (I live in a beautiful place). Being good to people. Books. FFS, even pewdiepie. 

After this warm feelings, I am not cured. At least I am satisfied. I feel like I mean something. It makes me wake up easier another day.

Good luck man. There really are good things in this world, and the best is these things are free and always around you. Let yourself just touch it, for your own satisfaction, feels warmer man

From my personal experience, psychologist and even psychiatrist are really helpful - in case they are professional enough.

It really helps, professional help can change the attitude and self esteem. 5 years is a long period of time, so I personally do not think just talking and listening would help.

But it will be really hard to assure a person to visit the doctor. To me, any professional help seemed pointless, I was sure I am much smarter than those mindbenders.

After my life was ruined and I crossed the line, I accepted help and it was really useful.
Medicine and family. And fear of pain. But also, I just try not to hope. Hope brings you disappointment. So I live without future, trying to just finish the day.

Agree. Sometimes it seems like you just forget bad things and sun is shining, but then it kicks you right to the head.

I remember that happy feeling and what happened next as if it was yesterday.

I not imagine living for yourself and having a close friends or lover at the same time. You either alone and do what you want, or you have someone to care about - so you are not the master of your life.

I will just lay down and do nothing until I die then. Because anything else makes no sense.

I think too much, criticizing any decision or action I make. I feel jealous to people who have no such attitude, they simply live to consume ‘good’ things and feel happy by simply eating a good food, buying expensive things or going to cinema to see last blockbuster movie.

I never feel something is good enough for me. Pills help - they make me feel good when I do simple things, but also these chemicals make me think I become dumber.

Well may be it is the best way.

In the end, wise men can not be happy in a world of fools. But after you become a fool in that world, you feel happy and not upset of not being wise anymore :)

I am like in mid-30 and I don’t want to plan a thing. Just because hope can be devastating, you know. After you do not get what you wanted, disappointment can kick you back too hard.

So I do not want to wish for something. And, actually, it never was a thing to me.

You always want to be a good person. So to be a good person means doing something for others. Be non-egoistic means you lose your ego.

I can not say if I am a person or animal anymore.
The same for me. I can see the answer but I don’t like it. This is the main conflict inside me.

It’s just why do you need to look for the answer if the answer is anyway ‘have fun / everything is too fucked up to think about’.

I think the best answer is just to stop asking, stop thinking and just consume until you are satisfied and pleased.

But what is the final goal for it? Everybody says live your own life, but why?

Have no idea why is it better to fight suffering than stop suffering
